card.name: Punctuation inside blood count lists
card.fires_on: A comma, colon or the word "low" right after a blood cell term such as leukocyte, neutrophil or leukopenia, just before the next count (platelets, WBC). It also fires on a comma after "GI toxicity" in NSAID warnings.
